question: According to Census of India 2011, what is the percentage of the rural population of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**68.8%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Census of India 2011:-**

 
 
• **The percentage of the rural population of India according to the Census of India 2011 is 0.688 or 68.8%.**
 
• This means that out of the total population of India, 68.8% live in rural areas while the remaining 31.2% live in urban areas. 
 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years to collect data about the population, economy, and social indicators of the country.
 
• The rural-urban divide is an important aspect of India's demographic profile as it has implications for policies related to agriculture, infrastructure, and social welfare.
 
• The government of India has launched various schemes and initiatives to address the challenges faced by rural areas and to promote inclusive growth.
 
• Some of these schemes include the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana, National Rural Livelihood Mission, and Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act.
